name: Chartered Logistics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Chartered Logistics Ltd is a logistic services provider dealing in domestic transportation of goods
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company has a large fleet (approx ~300) of owned and attached vehicles providing:
a) Road transport services
b) Special warehousing services
c) Cost & freight services
d) Door-to-door services
e) Project work
f) Customized carrier

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.01%
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.63 Cr.
